title: commit-anchored-throughput-contracts-and-expiry-ledger
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: customers with reserved/dedicated capacity asked for precise throughput guarantees tied to commitments and a way to reclaim unused reserved capacity when commitments expire. This PR introduces a commit-anchored throughput contract model and an expiry ledger that tracks per-tenant commitments, their effective windows, and decay/transfer rules. Design: 1) commit_ledger component: records commitments as immutable anchors with start/expiry timestamps and nominal throughput qps values; 2) soft-expiry policy: on expiry a commit enters a decay window instead of immediate revocation so running workloads get graceful degradation; 3) reservation harmonizer: background controller that reconciles current capacity against active anchors and soft-expired entries, producing reallocation suggestions; 4) autoscaler hook: the scale decider reads the ledger to satisfy guaranteed throughput first, then opportunistic capacity; 5) telemetry exporter: new metrics exposed (commit_effective_qps, commit_decay_fraction, ledger_reclaimed_qps) and a per-tenant utilization report that correlates committed vs consumed throughput using HDR histograms. Backwards compatibility: ledger is additive and default policies preserve current autoscaler behavior unless teams opt into commit enforcement via a per-tenant flag. Rollout plan: gated feature flag, staged rollout to internal dedicated clusters, 2-week canary, then opt-in for customers, finally default-enforcement after telemetry validation. Testing: unit tests for ledger reconciliation, integration test that simulates commit expiry, load tests to validate autoscaler interaction under saturation. Security and observability: audit events for create/extend/expire are emitted; metrics are labeled with tenant_id and commit_id; RBAC checks added to commit API. This description contains links and references inlined: Linear ENG-3182 covers API surface; ENG-4221 covers telemetry format. Checklist: [x] spec doc updated [x] ledger storage migration safe [x] autoscaler integration tests [x] telemetry dashboard prototype [x] docs and console UI follow-up PR

release_notes: Add commit-anchored throughput contracts and expiry ledger. New telemetry metrics: commit_effective_qps, commit_decay_fraction, ledger_reclaimed_qps. Admins can opt into commit enforcement via feature flag. Migration: run new SQL migration in maintenance window.
qa_summary: Unit, integration, and load tests run; staged canary in internal dedicated cluster for 7 days with no regressions. Telemetry dashboards plotted and reviewed by SRE team.
notes_for_ops: Run migrations with --chunk-size=10000 during low traffic window. If experiencing reclaim spikes, temporarily toggle commit enforcement false via console feature flag 'commit-ledger-toggle'. Audit events are prefixed 'commit.ledger.'.
